correctness.rationale: The deterministic exhaustive geometric proof was checked against the actual unit-ball vertices (±1,±r),(±r,±1), r=sqrt(2)-1. Quotient duality gives dist(y,Rx)=|det(x,y)|/max_{z in B}|det(x,z)|. Dihedral isometries reduce x to edge x=(1,t), |t|<r with unique supporting functional s, so unit y=(0,±1) and reverse distance 1/(1+r|t|)>=1/(1+r²). For vertex x=(1,r), the entire normal cone yields directions y=(q,-1)/N(q,-1), 0<=q<=1. Here det denominator 1+r², N(q,-1)=1 for q<=r or (1+q)/sqrt2 for q>=r, and expression (1+rq)/[(1+r²)N(q,-1)] is >=1/(1+r²) because sqrt2(1+rq)-(1+q)=r(1-q)>=0. Equality at q=0 and q=1. Therefore d0=(2+sqrt2)/4 and sqrt(1-d0²)=sqrt((5-2sqrt2)/8) for all Birkhoff pairs, not mere sampled pairs. Independently checked the radical, vertex-branch algebra using SymPy, as well as the exact source `verify.py`; its finite sampling is supplemental.
